d.t: SLOPE CORRECTOR FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Slope Corrector is an accessory used to accommodate slope corrections arising from falls created on concrete surfaces for drainage purposes. Slope correctors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), while fire-rated slope correctors area manufactured from reinforced thermoplastics, and can correct for slopes of 1% to 5%. SikaRoof VersiJack Slope Corrector is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Slope corrector for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and ares with hardscape finishes.
